data.description:
## Summary
Bootstrap a fresh host project via create-dso-app.sh in a temporary directory, patch dso-config.conf to enable merge.strategy=pr, and verify the bootstrapped project is ready for E2E CI verification.

## Testing Mode
RED — new behavior (E2E verification script that exercises the fetched-assets runner mode branch).

## Acceptance Criteria
- GIVEN create-dso-app.sh is invoked in $RUNNER_TEMP
  WHEN the bootstrap completes
  THEN a valid .claude/dso-config.conf is present with merge.strategy=pr (manually patched)
- GIVEN the bootstrapped project
  WHEN the CI workflow runs
  THEN the Resolve-and-fetch step uses tier 3 (marketplace.json HEAD pin) to resolve the DSO plugin version
- Prerequisite checks are explicit: if gh auth scope insufficient, Anthropic API creds absent, or create-dso-app.sh exits non-zero, the test FAILS with a clear log message (never silently passes)
- Bootstrap is idempotent: re-running when $RUNNER_TEMP already contains the project skips bootstrap and patches config if needed

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh (new test script)
- .test-index (add RED marker: tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh [test_host_bootstrap_and_config_patch])

## Implementation Notes
- Use `create-dso-app.sh --non-interactive` or equivalent quiet flag if available
- Patch command: `sed -i 's/^merge\.strategy=.*/merge.strategy=pr/' .claude/dso-config.conf`
- Prerequisite guard: `gh auth status` exit code + `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` env check before proceeding
- Store bootstrapped project path in a temp state file for use by the next task
data.title: Bootstrap host project and configure for E2E CI llm-review verification
